rooms.name: The Library
rooms.desc: Shelves cut into the black glass. Each one is a theme folder of the vault.

rooms.name: The Hearth
rooms.desc: Tally's desk faces the way in, with the ledger open. A brazier on either side of the entrance, and a still pool in the far corner that reflects nothing quite right.

rooms.name: The Graph Room
rooms.desc: Notes hang in the dark as points of light, joined by thin lines where one links to another.

rooms.name: The Archive
rooms.desc: Cold memory. Long low shelves of old log entries. Tally only comes here when something calls for it.

rooms.name: The Entrance Hall
rooms.desc: The way in. The door behind you leads back out.

rooms.name: The Outbox
rooms.desc: Loose pages Tally has written for you: digests, reviews, simulations.
